_note.cad_first_policy: Muc tieu mac dinh la xuat file CAD (.dxf/.dwg). KHONG tu dong xuat PDF (export_pdf=False) hay preview PNG (render_preview=False) khi nguoi dung khong ghi chu yeu cau.
_note.audit_contract: schema 2.0: full is default; PASS requires physical checks and all required gates. Missing/stale evidence => NEEDS_REVIEW. physical PASS never certifies 20/20 gates. See docs/MCP_DCE_CAD_CONTRACT.md.
_note.scratch_policy: Virtual Drive Guard: local fixed NTFS/ReFS C:/D: only. Optional DCE_CAD_SCRATCH_ROOT; unsafe overrides fall back to local Temp. render_cad_plan, resolve_cad_collisions and PNG destinations are redirected; use actual output paths from the response. pdf_path is a read-only input.
_note.vision_lifecycle: render_preview -> consume_preview returns image content and automatically deletes the PNG; direct file readers call release_preview after inspection. Abandoned completed previews expire after 24h and are swept on the next allocation. Edit revisions are retained.
